vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: lingxi-memory
Version: 1.1.10

The Lingxi-MindVault skill is a legitimate automation tool designed to extract tasks and knowledge from OpenClaw session logs and sync them to a user's Feishu (Lark) workspace. The bundle consists of bash scripts (session_check.sh, do_extract_and_write.sh) that monitor the local sessions directory, filter relevant chat history, and use an AI agent to summarize and write data to Feishu via official OpenClaw tools. It follows security best practices by using environment variables for sensitive resource IDs, implementing process locking to prevent race conditions, and ensuring temporary files are cleaned up via traps. No evidence of data exfiltration to unauthorized third parties or malicious command execution was found.

llm.summary: The skill's code and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (reading OpenClaw session files, extracting memories with the OpenClaw agent, and writing to Feishu), but there are a few operational/information-handling details and a registry metadata inconsistency you should be aware of before installing.

dimensions.detail: The skill claims to read OpenClaw sessions, extract memories with the OpenClaw agent, and write to Feishu (L2/L3/L4). The scripts, SKILL.md, and skill.json all request the Feishu IDs/tokens and call openclaw agent/CLI — this aligns with the stated purpose. However, the registry summary provided earlier shows 'Required env vars: none' and 'Required binaries: none', which contradicts the included skill.json and SKILL.md that require FEISHU_* variables and the openclaw CLI; that metadata mismatch should be corrected/clarified.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Scripts explicitly read OpenClaw session files (sessions.json and individual .jsonl files), create/process marking files in workspace and /tmp, and invoke the local openclaw agent/CLI to perform AI extraction and to send Feishu writes/notifications. This is within scope for a memory-extraction skill. Important privacy/operational notes: the extraction prompt embeds the FEISHU tokens/IDs and other context into a temporary prompt file which is passed to the agent; temporary files are cleaned up with traps but exist briefly on disk. The agent will process raw conversation content (potentially sensitive) and is instructed to call tools that use the provided tokens — review whether you are comfortable with this data flow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No external downloads or package installs are specified in the registry; the skill is instruction/script-based and asks you to copy scripts into the OpenClaw workspace and set up a cron job. No remote URL downloads or package installs are embedded, which is low risk from an install-code provenance perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires FEISHU_USER_OPEN_ID, L2_APP_TOKEN, L2_TABLE_ID, L3_DOC_ID, L4_DOC_ID (declared in skill.json and SKILL.md). Those credentials are directly used to write into your Feishu account and to notify a user — that is proportionate to the stated purpose. Two caveats: (1) the initial registry metadata omitted these required env vars (inconsistency); (2) the tokens/IDs are embedded into the AI prompt/temporary files, which increases the risk of inadvertent exposure if other processes/users on the host can read /tmp or if agent output logs are mishandled.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no indications the skill forces itself into all agents. The scripts create and manage marker files under the workspace (memory/.extracted_sessions, memory/.processing_sessions) and use a lock under /tmp — expected behavior for a cron-driven background script. The skill does not appear to modify other skills or global agent configuration beyond its own workspace artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: 1) Confirm the registry metadata mismatch — skill.json and SKILL.md require FEISHU_* env vars and the openclaw CLI, so do not trust the earlier 'none' listing for required envs/binaries. 2) Only install if you trust the host environment and are okay with OpenClaw session contents being processed and sent to Feishu (L2/L3/L4). Sensitive conversations will be read and transmitted to Feishu; avoid using this skill with highly sensitive data. 3) Prefer creating and using a Feishu service account or tokens with minimal permissions (only the tables/docs needed) rather than personal high-privilege tokens. 4) Run the scripts in an isolated user account (avoid running as root) and ensure /tmp is not world-readable on your system to reduce transient exposure of prompt/output files. 5) Inspect and, if needed, modify the scripts so tokens are not directly injected into prompts or are passed to tools in a safer way; consider rotating tokens after first run for extra precaution. 6) If you need higher assurance, request the publisher/source (no homepage provided) or run the skill in a sandboxed environment first. If anything about the metadata or code provenance is unclear, treat installation as higher risk.
